note: Documented assumptions for India, each with its source and the date it applies to. A snapshot gathered on the compiled_on date, not live rates.

fd_1y.name: One-year fixed deposit rate, State Bank of India, general public (tenor one year to less than two years, retail deposits under three crore rupees; senior citizens get more)
fd_1y.as_of_means: the date this rate took effect (still the current rate card when compiled)
fd_1y.evidence: Rate card, columns 'Revised Rates for Public w.e.f.15/12/2025': row '1 Year to less than 2 years 6.25'. Senior citizens 6.75. Page fetched 2026-11-05 (the page says last updated 19-10-2026).

savings_account.name: Savings account interest rate, State Bank of India, all balances
savings_account.as_of_means: the date this rate took effect (still current when compiled)
savings_account.evidence: 'Savings Bank Interest Rate (w.e.f. 15.06.2025) Across all account Balances 2.50% p.a.' Page fetched 2026-11-05.

ppf.name: Public Provident Fund rate notified for the current quarter, compounded yearly
ppf.as_of_means: the start of the quarter this rate is notified for, which ends 2026-12-31

source.organisation: Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs (office memorandum of 2026-09-30), as published by Indian Bank

ppf.evidence: Secondary source: Indian Bank's page cites 'Office Memorandum (OM) F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026', column 'Rate of interest from 01.10.2026 to 31.12.2026', row 'Public Provident Fund (PPF) 7.10 % ... Annually'. The DEA and NSI pages could not be fetched (certificate errors); press reports (Free Press Journal, Business Today, TaxGuru) agree PPF stays at 7.1% for Oct-Dec 2026. Fetched 2026-11-05.

inflation_cpi.name: Consumer price inflation, all India, year on year (CPI Combined, new base-year series, provisional), September over the September before
inflation_cpi.as_of_means: the end of the month the figure measures; released 2026-10-12

source.organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, National Statistics Office

inflation_cpi.evidence: 'PRESS RELEASE OF CONSUMER PRICE INDEX ON BASE 2024=100 FOR SEPTEMBER, 2026', dated 12 October 2026: 'Year-on-year inflation rate based on All India Consumer Price Index (CPI) with base year 2024 for the month of September, 2026 over September, 2025 is 5.54% (Provisional).' Rural 6.08, urban 4.88; August 2026 final 4.83. Not comparable with the old 2012=100 series. The October figure is due mid-November 2026. Fetched 2026-11-05.

rbi_repo.name: Reserve Bank of India policy repo rate
rbi_repo.as_of_means: the date the Monetary Policy Committee decided it
rbi_repo.evidence: Press release of Oct 07, 2026: the MPC, at its meeting of October 5 to 7, 2026, 'unanimously voted to increase the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50 per cent' (from 5.25). Next meeting December 2 to 4, 2026. Fetched 2026-11-05.

equity_long_run.name: Long-run Indian equity return: the Nifty50 Total Return Index's compound annual growth since the index began, before fund costs and tax. A past return used as a planning assumption, not a promise or a forecast
equity_long_run.as_of_means: the end of the period measured; the index's base date is 1995-11-03
equity_long_run.evidence: Nifty 50 factsheet dated October 30, 2026, Statistics table: 'Total Return 1.95 -10.91 -9.45 6.70 12.15' for QTD, YTD, 1 Year, 5 Years, Since Inception; 'Returns for greater than one year are CAGR returns.' Base date November 03, 1995. The 5-year TRI CAGR is 6.70 and the 1-year -9.45. The URL is replaced each month. Read 2026-11-05.

debt_fund.name: Long-run Indian debt return: the Nifty Composite Debt Index's annualised return since the index began, before fund costs and tax. An index, not a fund category average; a past return used as a planning assumption, not a promise or a forecast
debt_fund.as_of_means: the end of the period measured; the index family's base date is 2001-09-03
debt_fund.evidence: Nifty Fixed Income Aggregate Indices factsheet, October 2026, 'Returns as on Oct 31, 2026': 'NIFTY Composite Debt Index ... -1.93 0.24 -0.05 5.30 7.41' for 3M, 6M, 1 Yr, 3 Yr, Since Inception; 'Returns for periods longer than 1 year are annualized'. Base date September 03, 2001; launch date February 09, 2018 (earlier values presumably back-calculated; the factsheet does not say). The URL is replaced each month. Read 2026-11-05.
